svg.title: The ceiling: fifteen paired tasks, one discordant pair
svg.desc: Fifteen tiles, one per paired task, each run once without the plugin (condition A) and once with KX's q plugin (condition B). Five tiles, tasks 02, 07, 10, 13 and 14, are filled dark: both conditions wrote byte-for-byte identical q. Eight tiles, tasks 01, 03, 04, 05, 06, 09, 11 and 12, are outlined: the code differed but scored identically. Task 15 is outlined and marked as a shared miss: both conditions produced the correct joined table but failed the exact output diff on an extra line, identically. Task 08 is the only discordant pair, highlighted: the plugin condition won on one checklist item, a judgement call about an unnecessary binding. A summary row reads: correctness 14 of 15 in both conditions; idiomaticity 73 of 75 without the plugin and 74 of 75 with it; discordant pairs, 1, where an exact two-sided sign test needs at least six, all one way, to reach 5% significance. The footer says the test never engaged: baseline already solves these tasks.
svg.text: 15 PAIRED TASKS · WITHOUT vs WITH KX'S q PLUGIN
The comparison never got a chance to run.
